caption_L1: Here a is a line plot called Average daily cigarette consumption in Great Britain from 2000 to 2016 , by gender (in cigarettes per day). There is a linear scale with a minimum of 2000 and a maximum of 2015 along the x-axis, labeled Year. A linear scale of range 0 to 15 can be found along the y-axis, labeled Men.
caption_L2L3: The general trend of smoking is declining in men. Although the levels from the year 2000 have dropped, and sometimes risen again, the rise has never been a bigger amount than the start point in 2000, and the rise has never been bigger than the level of smoking recorded at the last drop, and so the general trend is consistently a downward one.
